meta.name: $DIAL — CRT-in-Brass design tokens
meta.aesthetic: Hybrid: phosphor CRT screen embedded in a Victorian brass time-machine chassis. The chat surface is glass + scanlines. The chassis around it is engraved brass, mechanical, tactile.

void.description: Deep vacuum behind the machine — backdrop edges, drop-shadow base.

brassDark.description: Inset shadow on brass surfaces, panel undersides.

brassBase.description: Default brass face — toolbars, frames, rivets.

brass.description: Primary brass — bezels, dials, button caps.

brassBright.description: Polished highlight — engraved letterforms, lit edges, hover sheen.

screen.description: CRT glass dark — chat panel background, terminal field.

phosphor.description: Bright phosphor — cursor, current-line text, dial readout.

phosphorDim.description: Body text inside CRT — slightly burnt-in green.

redFault.description: Hard error — connection lost, fault lamp.

onChassis.description: Engraved label text on brass — section headers, button labels.

display.description: Engraved brass labels, panel headings, the machine's nameplate. Choose a serif with metal-engraving energy — IM Fell or Cormorant SC work; nothing geometric.

mono.description: CRT screen interior — terminal text, dial readout digits, the chat itself.

body.description: Reserved for long-form marketing copy outside the machine (Lore, How-to-Buy, Roadmap sections). Should feel like an instruction booklet, not part of the machine.

rivet.description: Round brass rivets and cap heads.

panel.description: Outer brass panel corners — barely rounded; this is hammered metal, not plastic.

screen.description: CRT screen corners — generous rounding; CRTs bulge.

rivet.description: Distance from edge to rivet center.

panel.description: Outer chassis padding around the CRT screen.

panelInset.description: Brass panel face — concave, lit from above.

screenInset.description: CRT screen recessed into the chassis — heavy inner shadow.

rivet.description: Brass rivet — small drop + bright top highlight.

buttonResting.description: Physical button at rest — sits ~2px above its socket.

buttonPressed.description: Button pressed — socket inversion, no drop.

phosphorHot.description: Active cursor, current dial readout — strong bloom.

brassWarm.description: Hover sheen on brass buttons and dials.

scanlines.description: CRT horizontal scanline overlay — paint over .screen layer with mix-blend-mode: multiply or low opacity.

phosphorPersistence.description: Sub-pixel blur on CRT text to mimic phosphor smear. Combine with text-shadow glow.

vignette.description: Heavy vignette around the CRT screen interior.

brushedBrass.description: Vertical noise on brass surfaces (0.15 opacity). Generate at brand/assets/textures/brushed-brass.png.

dialRotate.description: Time dial settling — slight overshoot, mechanical inertia. Never linear.

buttonPress.description: Hard, fast, satisfying. Should feel like a real switch closing.

screenBoot.description: Horizontal sweep + flicker on CRT power-on (existing behaviour — keep).

scanlineCreep.description: Scanline overlay drifts vertically. Subtle — 1-2px range. Loops forever.

phosphorFlicker.description: Tiny opacity wobble on CRT layer — 0.95 to 1.0. Never regular.

gaugeWobble.description: Decorative gauges (load, signal) wobble gently while active.

controls.description: Dials, buttons, presets (sit proud of chassis).
